other.tags: Bossa nova. Nylon string acoustic guitar plays syncopated fingerstyle chords with a steady thumb-plucked bassline on beats 1 and 3. A solo flute performs melodic improvisations using trills, grace notes, and breathy articulation. The percussion consists of a shaker playing consistent sixteenth notes and a woodblock or rimshot hitting the clave rhythm. The arrangement is sparse and acoustic. Key of G major. Tempo is 110 BPM. 4/4 time signature.

bass.tags: Funk instrumental featuring a prominent slap bass line and syncopated percussion. The bass utilizes thumb slaps and finger pops in a repetitive 16th-note pattern. A dry, acoustic drum kit plays a steady backbeat with occasional ghost notes on the snare. A clean electric guitar performs rhythmic muted scratches and staccato chords on the offbeats. The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of E minor. The production is dry with minimal reverb, emphasizing the percussive attack of the strings.

[dry acoustic drums enter with steady kick and snare]

[Main Groove]
[clean electric guitar rhythmic scratching]
[syncopated 16th-note bass pattern continues]
[closed hi-hat eighth-note pulse]

drums.tags: Funk rock. Clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, percussive riff using 16th-note scratches and double-stops. A slap bass guitar follows the guitar rhythm with aggressive thumb pops and finger plucks. Drums feature a tight, dry snare sound and a crisp hi-hat playing 16th-note patterns with occasional open accents. The tempo is 115 BPM in the key of E minor. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interlocking rhythmic relationship between the bass and guitar.

[snare hits on beats 2 and 4]
[occasional open hi-hat accents]
